description: Team BackSpace is a 100% all-female multidisciplinary team from Ceará, Brazil, driven by a passion for science and technology. Composed of 5 students from IFCE and UFC (two developers and three designers), we are proud members of the Apple Developer Academy. By blending robust technical skills with user-centered design and accessibility, we strive to create immersive, meaningful digital experiences that educate and inspire our users.
